claims.A2: PyPI project name molxmpnn is unregistered (the JSON API returns 404).
claims.A3: Every published aminx release on PyPI is an alpha or other pre-release version.

prereg.question: Is the PyPI name molxmpnn free today, and is every existing aminx release a pre-release (which bounds who a repurposed or shimmed aminx name can surprise)?
prereg.expect_if_true: molxmpnn_status is 404; aminx_status is 200 and aminx_all_prerelease is True.
prereg.expect_if_false: molxmpnn_status is 200 (name taken) or aminx_all_prerelease is False (a stable aminx release exists). A transport-failure status means the probe is inconclusive and must be re-run under a new id.
